environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on a single EC2 t3.micro instance, directly exposed via public IP on port 8000. No reverse proxy or load balancer. KEY_LIFETIME_SECONDS=3600 (1 hour rotation). Network latency is stable (<1ms jitter from same AZ). Attacker can make thousands of requests per second from a co-located instance to perform statistical timing analysis on the character-by-character comparison.

config.deployment: bare EC2 t3.micro, public IP, no proxy
